Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The prerequisite pair rows now carry served query/reference TrialTally values, but BundleTables.pairColumns still contains only pair identity, role/scale, score/absence and reason. comparisons ignores both tallies when constructing rows. Existing ExportBundleSuite verifies pair scores and their absence labels; it does not verify the requested outside-window columns. Thus the protocol prerequisite is delivered and this export slice remains.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/figures/BundleTables.scala:248
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/figures/BundleTables.scala:285
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/figures/ExportBundleSuite.scala:294

Remaining / next action: Add nullable query/reference outside-window count, denominator and share columns from the served TrialTally values, with explicit units/schema meanings; preserve unavailable as missing, distinguish true zero, include generated README columns, and test independently against served pair pages.

Disposition: Keep open.
